Mia often helps me with history. After school, we play together. We often go to the cinema together. We were guests at a small guesthouse.
Lily usually eats bread for lunch. Lily wants to visit Xi'an. My friend Mia is very kind. Best of all, fish live in water.
Mia likes bread too. The moon-lit yard is not far from my home. The temple fair is big and clean.
